attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The core change swaps explicit per-key property assignment for a generic JsonObject.Merge in DefaultIndexProfileHandler, altering how index profile properties (Elasticsearch/Lucene metadata) are combined during create/update across all tenants, and the coupled recipe schema changes imply dependency on other in-flight index-profile refactoring that isn't fully visible here."}

reason: The core change swaps explicit per-key property assignment for a generic JsonObject.Merge in DefaultIndexProfileHandler, altering how index profile properties (Elasticsearch/Lucene metadata) are combined during create/update across all tenants, and the coupled recipe schema changes imply dependency on other in-flight index-profile refactoring that isn't fully visible here.
